Very disappointed
Jan 2025 • Solo
I am very disappointed with the experience I had. I had booked a table through the restaurant’s website and was looking forward to an evening of good food and live music. However, when I arrived, I was informed that the entire restaurant had been booked for a private event. This was extremely frustrating as I had received no prior notice about this. It completely disrupted my evening, and I had to change my plans last minute. I hope the restaurant improves its communication to avoid disappointing other customers in the future.
